experiments.name: payload
experiments.description: Bounded reader ownership and lazy inbound application validation before the runtime/API redesign.

experiments.name: runtime-final
experiments.description: Initial coordinated runtime. Rejected scheduling behavior: large-message and microservice latency regressed.

experiments.name: turns
experiments.description: Same-poll continuation after output. Did not recover the regressions.

experiments.name: lanes
experiments.description: Independent readiness and explicit application completion recovered large-message latency; service chains still regressed.

experiments.name: queued
experiments.description: Owning output accepts while physical flush is pending. Correct ownership separation, little isolated service latency change.

experiments.name: admission
experiments.description: Calls attempt transactional admission; blocked publication is distinct from fallback. Service latency still about 31% behind C++ in the focused run, despite matching captured IO counts.

experiments.name: phase
experiments.description: Output progresses between buffered protocol turns. Recovered service-chain overlap; retained the full 480,000-sample sweep and focused comparisons. Review subsequently tightened the capacity-retry fence.

experiments.name: fences
experiments.description: Selected: retries require pending output that can release capacity. Without that fence, capacity exhaustion remains an error instead of sleeping indefinitely.

phase_followup.native_campaign: Kept running to completion in its existing child process.
phase_followup.diagnostic_chain: Stopped the parent qualification shell before diagnostics so the corrected capacity-fence candidate can receive final diagnostics.
phase_followup.reason: Review found that an output-capacity failure could wait without a pending physical completion to release storage. Added an explicit pending-output fence and regression test before final source qualification.

validation.detail: 328 RPC, 202 allocating engine and 151 allocating wire unit tests; 69 root integration tests including TCP, Unix resources, policy, cancellation, multiparty joins, answer adoption and TLC replays. RPC doctests: 3 passed, 4 ignored.

Core library and integration suites passed during the reader redesign. All 192 strict-provenance Miri executions passed across alloc/unaligned and Stacked/Tree Borrows. The tested core, wire and question-ownership files are unchanged in the selected source; later runtime/output changes received native unit and integration coverage.

Pinned Verus verified 155 production/source contracts and 139 temporal-library obligations. All 44 deliberate faults were rejected, including the new live-exchange-owner reuse fault. The earlier install/download/checkout attempts are retained; tools and the proof library were installed from checksum-verified/pinned sources.

Strict Clippy on all targets of core, engine, wire and RPC; root tests/examples compile; no-default-features wire and core sync_reader configurations; formatting for the workspace and both maintained benchmark hosts. Earlier maintained compio and upstream Rust fixture compile checks passed.

480,000 selected native samples, five runs per cell, full fixture budgets and all 240 mixed checks verified. All 48 original frame pairs and 304 directed topology edges match received frames. Native timing is separate from builds, tests and instrumentation.

validation.check: Repository, documentation, workflows and source replay
validation.detail: Repository and wiki checks and workflow checks passed. The exact selected source patch reconstructs its recorded tree. Literal source.patch whitespace is preserved; source/document whitespace checks exclude its unchanged diff context.

validation.detail: These remain separate from affected tests and benchmark interoperability. The parent commit CI failed in its tests-and-coverage job; its dedicated performance and CodeQL workflows succeeded. New-head hosted checks are not claimed here.
